- [LEXP.8.8] **`const` RHS.** Compile-time-constant expressions — the
  runtime-free foldable subset over literals, earlier consts, and imported
  consts: arithmetic, comparison, bitwise/shift, `and`/`or`/`not`, unit
  literals + same-dimension conversion + unit assertions, the total `::`
  conversions ([LCST.4.5.2]), the global math
  builtins ([LEXP.3.1]), the `math`, `distance` and `calendar` members over constant
  operands ([LIMP.3.3.4]), each by the composition its clause fixes. A `String`
  is folded only as a literal: `+` over a `String` is refused here as everywhere
  ([LEXP.7.1a]). [LEXP.8.8.1] fixes the value a right-hand side folds to, and
  [LEXP.8.8.2] the refusal of one with no value. `=`-introduced, optionally `: type`-annotated (a scalar
  builtin type, or a canonical unit; **checked** against the folded value
  — [LGRA.4.1]). Any construct requiring a
  runtime value — including a runtime-`Json` *leaf read* — is a compile error naming it ([LGRA.13.3]).
